title: Green Bank Telescope
geometryBasis: Observatory-surveyed support axis, mapped operating area, and the original USGS one-metre grade. The Observatory and NRAO provide the reflector dimensions, axle elevation, and track diameter.
sectionBasis: An open steel support cradle sits below the elevated 100 by 110 metre asymmetrical reflecting surface. An off-axis trussed arm carries the subreflector outside the collecting aperture.
limitations: The telescope is a static high-elevation pose. The absolute azimuth and instantaneous observation target are representative.
The aperture span, base and axle are survey and specification based. Individual reflector panels, cabling, service equipment and connection details are represented at a coarser scale.
